messages.subject: Add users programmatically
parts:
Hello,

I am using shinyapps.io professional plan. I would like to create an app that hides the certain data and input/output widgets from unregistered users but give full access to registered users (creating myapp.com/lite vs myapp.com/pro like setups). I will publish two separate apps (one for lite and one for pro).

I plan on creating a third shiny app for the user to register to create a pro account. This app will be a simple form where the user puts in a user name and password. I would like to take this info and upload it to the pro-version app's list of registered users. Can this be done programatically?

I see some previous discussions regarding this matter: Such script seems to be disabled (as of 2/15/15). Is it available now?
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!newtopic/shinyapps-users/shinyapps-users/g4G9H0ATkxo


- Kim

messages.author: 91c331ed323555b6
messages.subject: Re: Add users programmatically
parts:
I actually found the solution.. posting here so other Google searchers can see them:

It looks like when you upload your app to shinyapps.io, you need to include a line of code that register the app with your account. This is the thing you did with token and secret password to register your RStudio IDE 

> shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name='your-account', token='your-token', secret='your-secret')

I personally did this in server.R but I am not sure if anywhere else would be better (global.R maybe?) I am also unsure if library(shinyapps) is better or library(rsconnect) is better.

Then your shinyapp can do things like shinyapps::showUsers(appName = "your app name", server = "shinyapps.io") and shinyapps:addAuthorizedUser(email = "youremail", ...) etc. to add users to your app

Beware, when there seems to be a bug where if you attempt to add authorized user when twice (same email), then the app crashes. Also note that showUsers() return a data.frame of user info

Best,
Leon Kim
